incomeDefinition: Segment income includes sales, other income, and amounts counted between the two businesses. Group total income removes those internal amounts.
definition: For the continuing businesses, the two segment results add up to group profit before unusual items and tax. The table excludes the packaged snack unit that was sold.
sourceLabel: Audited annual report filed with BSE
location: PDF pages 240, 278, 294 and 302–303. Consolidated profit and loss statement and Notes 31, 41 and 47.
notes: After removing ₹149.6 crore counted between parts of the group, group total income was ₹6,829.7 crore. Sales from operations were ₹6,646.2 crore. A net ₹48.3 crore charge for changes to labour rules and a property write-down reduced the continuing result before tax. The group earned ₹176.1 crore after tax from continuing operations. Including the discontinued packaged snack business and the gain on its sale, reported group profit after tax was ₹332.8 crore.
insight: Running cinemas brought in most reported segment income and earnings. That row includes tickets, cinema food, advertising and related income together.
revenueTotalLabel: Gross segment income before removing internal amounts
